mitigation_mechanism: Mangroves dissipate wave energy, by up to 75% over a few tens of metres, and lower storm-surge water levels by 5 to 50 centimetres per kilometre of width in measurements from south Florida, where a hurricane surge attenuation rate of 9.4 cm/km has also been measured over relatively continuous mangrove forest, slightly lower along a river corridor [ev_frmg_leon17_1], and where a validated model also showed a much smaller inundated area with mangroves during Hurricane Wilma [ev_flood_hazard_gijsman21_2, ev_flood_hazard_mcivor12_1, ev_flood_hazard_mcivor12_5]. A global model estimates that losing current mangroves would flood 28% more people each year, and in India villages behind mangrove belts had fewer storm-surge deaths and lower household losses [ev_flood_hazard_menendez20_1, ev_flood_hazard_mcivor12_10, ev_flood_hazard_mcivor12_9]; compilers for mangrove afforestation in Bangladesh and mangrove buffers in the Philippines rate flood impacts as reduced [ev_flood_hazard_wocat_4300_2019_flood_impacts, ev_flood_hazard_wocat_578_2016_flood_impacts]. In Bangladesh, a World Bank modelling study finds that mangrove belts in front of coastal embankments cut shear stress at the embankment toe by 7%-16% where belts average 60 m wide and by 45%-72% where they average 477 m, and a cited model finds 500 m mangrove afforestation patches can mitigate surge current velocities by up to 90% [ev_erosion_hazard_wbmang25_1, ev_erosion_hazard_wbmang25_2, ev_flood_hazard_wbmang25_2]. A meta-analysis of field measurements finds that existing mangroves reduce wave heights by 31% (95% CI: 25–37%) [ev_frmg_nara16_1]. Of mangrove restoration projects reviewed globally, 50% state that the habitat provides improved protection from storm events, and a cited economic model for northern Vietnam gives restoration scenarios higher cost-benefit ratios once the avoided maintenance cost of the sea dike system, protected from coastal storm surges by the mangroves, is counted [ev_frmg_nara16_5, ev_frmg_erw09_2].
caveats: Attenuation of tidal and surge water levels is far weaker than for short waves, up to 2 cm per 100 m and dependent on creeks, and the wind-wave figure comes from small-wave measurements rather than storm conditions [ev_flood_hazard_gijsman21_3, ev_flood_hazard_mcivor12_2]. Almost all literature units describe existing mangrove forests, with transfer to restored stands assumed, and protection depends on belt width, tree density, species and inundation depth. The measured surge data are from the USA, the global property benefit is smaller than the benefit to people, and the Bangladesh and Philippines units are compiler ratings rather than measurements [ev_flood_hazard_menendez20_2]. The Bangladesh study is modelled grey literature from the World Bank, and it finds mangroves have only a small effect (<4%) on design total water level because the surge dominates, so their benefit there is protection of embankments from erosion and currents rather than lower flood levels [ev_flood_hazard_wbmang25_1, ev_flood_hazard_wbmang25_2]. The wave and surge figures measure what standing mangroves do, not what planting achieves: the wave meta-analysis covers existing habitat, measured under ‘normal’ conditions of low waves, and the Florida surge rates are measurements over existing forest [ev_frmg_nara16_1, ev_frmg_leon17_1]. That a planted stand will deliver the same is assumed, not measured, in these units. The restoration-project share counts projects that report a benefit, self-reported rather than measured, and the Vietnam dike-cost result is a second-hand reading of the model [ev_frmg_nara16_5, ev_frmg_erw09_2].

mitigation_mechanism: Planted mangroves are credited with sheltering the coast and what lies behind it from typhoons. In northern Viet Nam a storm in 1987 caused serious damage to a three km-stretch of sea-dyke that cost 300,000 US dollars to repair, while during the 2005 storm the same dyke did not sustain any damage, which the evaluation attributes to the protective capacity of the mangrove forests [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ifrc11_1]; damage to private property fell further, from 90 per cent of shrimp farm value destroyed in 1996 to 25 per cent ten years later [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ifrc11_2]. Behind planted Sonneratia mangroves in Hainan, China, mean and extreme wind speed during typhoons were reduced by 59.4% and 53.2% [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_mcivor12_1]. Compilers for mangrove buffers in the Philippines and mangrove afforestation in Bangladesh rate the impacts of cyclones and rain storms as decreased [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_wocat_578_2016_impacts_of_cyclones_rain_storms, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_wocat_4300_2019_impacts_of_cyclones_rain_storms]. An independent World Bank evaluation in Vietnam's southern Mekong Delta draws the lesson that where reforestation was successful, land is accreting and farming and other economic activities are protected from storms, wind, and salt [ev_frmg_vnppar_8].
caveats: Who benefits differs by unit: the sea-dyke saving is a public asset protected for the coast behind the stand, while the shrimp-farm figure is damage avoided on private property [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ifrc11_1, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ifrc11_2]. The Viet Nam results are before-and-after comparisons between storms with no control site, attributed to the mangroves by evaluators of the implementing Red Cross programme, and the Hainan figure is a secondary citation [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ifrc11_1, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_ifrc11_2, ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_mcivor12_1]. The Philippines and Bangladesh units are compiler ratings, not measurements, and the Bangladesh compiler rates only a slight reduction [ev_wind_cyclone_hazard_wocat_4300_2019_impacts_of_cyclones_rain_storms]. The Mekong Delta lesson is the evaluator's synthesis of field findings, not a measurement, and the same passage records the reverse where mangrove seedlings were planted too small, at too shallow a depth and not carefully monitored: there the coastline is moving inland, sweeping away solid ground and endangering the dikes built to protect the resettled areas [ev_frmg_vnppar_8]. Siting and establishment are the hinge: the protection reported here follows where the planting took hold, and the same coast lost ground where it did not.
